title: Negotiating and persuading / Kɔfale ye kɔfale kanbali
bridge: Espańe caaman, kɔfale kanbali furu fana walisa ka kaan a ka taa ni 'deberías' an ka 'tienes que', ye subjonctif ka 'para que' klaaɲi taara. Angle caaman, B2 ka taa, a mana ka kaan kelen ye maana, a ka 'would', 'could', 'might' ye 'I was wondering if...' ka taa. Kala ko 'hacer una contraoferta' ka 'to make a counteroffer' (a ka taa) ne, ma 'to suggest' ma subjonctif sii Angle caaman, o b'a ka taa ye verb boɲafɛ (suggest + infinitive). Tag questions manti ka 'isn't it?' ma '¿no?' ka taa, tuma Angle caaman a ka taa ni verb boɲafɛ ka kaanbali klaaɲi taara.
rule: Angle caaman B2 la, kɔfale kanbali furu fana walisa: 1) Modal verbs ka kaan kelen: 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Kɔrɛsi klaaɲi: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Kɔfale kanbali klaaɲi: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Kɔfale kanbali furu fana: 'What if we...?', 'How about...? + -ing', 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Kondisional ka taa: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (kondisional taali). Kɔfale kanbali furu fana walisa ka taa: 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...'. Taaɲin, 'suggest' ye 'recommend' ka taa ni 'that' + sujet + verb boɲafɛ (bina 's'), an ka gerundifɛ: 'I suggest that we wait' / 'I suggest waiting'. Subjonctif sii Espańe caaman ma Angle caaman.

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / A fɔlɔ a fana kɛ a yira fana tɛmɛ jɔlenw
bridge: A taali gi, i kɛra ka sɛbɛn 'ayɛ fɔlɔn' wala 'ayɛ sanjiyan' ka bɔ a fɔlɔw la, a bɔri 'lɛrɛ' ka bɔ a yiraw la. A lɔnnikɛlaw la, a fɔlɔw la a yiraw la fɔlɔ a ka jɔn a fɛ ka tɛmɛ jɔlenw kɛ a bɔ a ka sɔrɔw fana kɛ 'lɛrɛ a bɔ', 'a ka sababu', 'a ka tɛmɛ', to 'a ka kondisiyɔn' (mɛnsi 'if... then...'). Ala ga, 'ayɛ fɔlɔn' ka tɔgɔtɔgɔnni 'according to my opinion' ala ga a taali gi, nka 'in my opinion' ala ga i don ayɛ fɔlɔn. A taali gi, a lɔnnikɛlaw la, a ka modali verbw (would, could) ka tɔgɔ a fɔlɔw la a yiraw la fana ka tɛmɛ jɔlenw kɛ a bɔ a ka sɔrɔw fana.
rule: A lɔnnikɛlaw la a fɔlɔw la a yiraw la fɔlɔ a ka jɔn a fɛ ka tɛmɛ jɔlenw kɛ: 1) A fɔlɔw ka tɛmɛw: 'In my view', 'From my perspective', 'I would argue that', 'It seems to me that'. 2) A yiraw ka tɛmɛw: 'The reason for this is', 'This is due to', 'Given that', 'Considering that'. 3) A fɔlɔw ka fɛn: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'While it is true that...', 'Nevertheless'. 4) A kondisiyɔn tɛmɛw: 'If... then', 'Unless...', 'Provided that...'. 5) A sababu-fɛnw ka tɛmɛw: 'This leads to', 'As a result', 'Consequently'. B2 tɛmɛ: A taa kɛ a bɔ a ka jɔn a fɛ ka tɛmɛ jɔlenw kɛ a bɔ a ka sɔrɔw fana, a ka tɛmɛ tɔgɔw, to a ka verb tɛmɛw (present perfect wala past simple) a ka kɛlɛyaŋw fana.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu
bridge: Sɛbɛɛn, kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, an b’a sira ‘habría + participio’ wala ‘hubiera + participio’, nka, yɛngɛ la kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, an b’a sira ‘would have + past participle’ ma fanga la ‘had + past participle’ (third conditional). Kɔrɔsiw bɛɛ minw be sira ‘si habría’ la ‘if would have’ b’a fɔlɔ fɛ, nka yɛngɛ la kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, fanga kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu tun b’an ka sira ‘would’. An ka sira ‘might have’ kanu ‘could have’ yɛngɛ la kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, u b’an ka sira ‘podría haber’ wala ‘quizás habría’ sɛbɛɛn.
rule: Yɛngɛ la kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, an b’a sira ‘third conditional’ kanu ‘modal perfect structures’. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu fɔlɔ bɛɛ minw be sira ‘If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle’. Tɛmɛna: ‘If I had studied, I would have passed’. An ka sira ‘could have’ (kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu), ‘might have’ (kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu), ‘should have’ (kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu). Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu wala kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, an b’a sira ‘wish + past perfect’ (ojalá hubiera). An ka sira ‘would have’ tun b’an ka sira ‘if’ kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la. Kɛlɛya kɔfɛ kanu la, an ka tɛmɛ soloba: ‘Would you have...?’

title: Discussing abstract concepts / Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw
bridge: Espaɲe kan, kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw ye tiɲɛn wɛrɛ fɔlɔ, an ka jɔnya la subjonctif ('il est important que...', 'je crois que ce soit...') yɛrɛ fɔlɔw kanw ye. Angalɛ kan, subjonctif ka laminsira tɛ miiriya haw fɔlɔw la: o kɔrɔsi verb 'suggest', 'recommend', 'demand', yɛrɛ fɔlɔw kanw ye, yɛrɛ mɛ 'it is essential that...' fɔlɔw kanw ye. Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw angalɛ kan, 'freedom' wala 'justice' fɔlɔw kanw, an ka taa kɔnɔna defined article fɔlɔw kanw, kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw espaɲe kan 'la' ('la libertad') fɔlɔw kanw. Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw angalɛ kan, an ka taa kɔnɔna auxiliary 'do' ma sɔrɔ yɛrɛ nɔgɔya, yɛrɛ mɛ an ka taa kɔnɔna adjectives subject ye.
rule: Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw angalɛ kan B2 tɔgɔ la, i kɛlɛ: 1. Kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw singular/plural 'zero article' fɔlɔw kanw, kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw ('Freedom is important' vs 'La libertad es importante'). 2. Subordinate clauses 'that' + verb base form (subjonctif) fɔlɔw recommendation wala demand verbs ('I suggest that she be...') yɛrɛ adjectives fɔlɔw ('It is crucial that he attend'). 3. Structures ma kɛlɛya opinion: 'In my opinion', 'I believe that', 'It seems to me that', indicative fɔlɔw (subjonctif espaɲe kan fɔlɔw). 4. Clauses 'which' yɛrɛ 'that' fɔlɔw define yɛrɛ not define. 5. Modal verbs ma nuance: 'might', 'could', 'would', 'should' fɔlɔw possibility, condition wala advice. 6. Impersonal expressions 'it' ('It is obvious that', 'It is worth considering'). Kɛlɛya kɛmɛkɛla jɛnɲɔgɔnya kanw fɔlɔw angalɛ kan, taa kɔnɔna double negation, yɛrɛ sentence structure Sujet + Verbe + Objet.

title: Expressing complex emotions / A ka ɲèna fiman fiman sanjé
bridge: A taaliɛi do, mɔgɔ min b'a yira ko i ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni wala i ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, nka, a taaliɛi do, i kɛ ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o bɛɛ ka kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni. A ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o kɔrɔtɔsi bɛɛ yɛrɛ fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o bɛɛ ka kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni. A ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o kɔrɔtɔsi bɛɛ yɛrɛ fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o bɛɛ ka kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni.
rule: A taaliɛi do, a ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o kɔrɔtɔsi bɛɛ yɛrɛ: 1) Adɛɛsuman tɛɛniw kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni: 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw', 'kaɲaɲɛniw'. 2) 'Feel' + adɛɛsuman tɛɛni wala 'feel like' + gerundive ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni. 3) 'Get' + adɛɛsuman tɛɛni ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni (get frustrated, get overwhelmed). 4) Adɛɛsuman tɛɛniw kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni: 'homesick', 'heartbroken', 'overwhelmed'. 5) A ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni: 'on cloud nine' (ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni), 'down in the dumps' (ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni). A ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o kɔrɔtɔsi bɛɛ yɛrɛ 'nervous' yɛrɛ ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, 'anxious' yɛrɛ ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni; 'upset' yɛrɛ fiman fiman 'sad'. A taaliɛi do, a ka ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o kɔrɔtɔsi bɛɛ yɛrɛ 'I have' + ɲèna sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni, o bɛɛ ka kanu fiman fiman sanjé sɔrɔ k'o sɔrɔ adɛɛsuman tɛɛni 'I have a feeling'.

title: Formal Writing: Reports and Emails / Jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana: tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka tɛmɛw kɔrɔw
bridge: A taali gi, jògidenw bɛɛw bɛɛ ka jamana wɔrɔsira ka taa ye a bɛ yɔrɔ kɛ walisira ka taa ye. A sɛbɛn fɛ, jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana tɛ a lɔn fɔ, tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw ka taa ye. Hala tɔrɔn, a yɛrɛ fɔ a se ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw ka taa ye 'Le adjunto' ka tɛ 'I attach' (sɛbɛn fɛ) tɛ 'Please find attached' wala 'I have attached'. A sɛbɛn fɛ, jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye, a yɛrɛ fɔ a se ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw ka taa ye 'would' dɔn 'could' ka tɛ a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye. A sɛbɛn fɛ, a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye 'usted' wala a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye kɛlɛya kɔrɔw, amma a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye sira kɔrɔw dɔn fɔlɔw kɔrɔw.
rule: Tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw dɔn jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye B2 tɔgɔ, a tɛ fɔlɔ a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye sira kɔrɔw dɔn: 1) Tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw: 'Dear Mr. Smith', 'Dear Madam', 'Yours sincerely', 'Yours faithfully'. 2) Jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw dɔn fɔlɔw kɔrɔw: 'state' (tɛ 'say'), 'require' (tɛ 'need'), 'I would like to' (tɛ 'I want'), 'I am writing to inform you'. 3) Tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka fasaya: tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw, tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka taa ye, dɔn tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw wala tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka taa ye. 4) Yɔrɔ kɛ walisira: tɛmɛ fɔlɔw 'do not' tɛ 'don't', 'I would' tɛ 'I'd'. 5) Tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw: tɛmɛ fɔlɔw 'Introduction', 'Findings', 'Recommendations', dɔn jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw 'It was found that...' (A yɛrɛ fɔ a se ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka taa ye...). 6) Jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka tɛmɛ fɔlɔw: 'Could you please...', 'I would appreciate...', 'Would it be possible to...?'. Tɛmɛ fɔlɔw kɔrɔw ka taa ye, a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye 'please' tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw (hala tɔrɔn a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw), amma a bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye tɛmɛ fɔlɔw ka jamana kɔrɔw wala jògidenw bɛɛw ka jamana kɔrɔw ka taa ye.

title: Dealing with Conflict / Kɔnfli ji kɛ sɔrɔ sɔrɔ nin ka ban tɛna
bridge: Espaɲɛ kan, an bena tɛmɛ imperatifi direkiti ('Hableme lo que pasó') n'a tɛmɛ 'deberías' kɔnɔ conflicts ka ban tɛna. Ingili kan, muso jɔlenw kɔrɔlenw yɛrɛ fana: an bena tɛmɛ modali verbuw 'could' 'might' kɔnɔ, n'a tɛmɛ 'I feel...' tɔɔrɔ, a bɛɛ ka tɛmɛ tɔgɔtɔgɔn fɔlɔw ye. Tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye ko 'tienes que' tɛ 'you must' tɔɔrɔ, a bɛɛ ka tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye; o tɛmɛ 'you might want to' n'a 'maybe you could'.
rule: Kɔnfli ka ban tɛna Ingili kan B2 tɔgɔ, an bena tɛmɛ muso jɔlenw kɔrɔlenw n'a tɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye. Tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye: 1) Modali verbuw ka tɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye: 'could', 'might', 'would' (tɛmɛtɔ 'We could try...'). 2) Tɛmɛtɔ 'I feel', 'I think', 'I believe' ka tɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye. 3) Kondisɔna tɛmɛtɔw ka tɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye: 'If you..., we could...'. 4) Tɛmɛtɔ ka muso jɔlenw kɛlɛ: 'I understand', 'I see your point'. 5) Tɛmɛtɔ ka tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye: 'I wonder if you could...'. 6) Tɛmɛtɔ 'sorry' ka tɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye: 'I'm sorry if that came across the wrong way'. Tɛmɛ tɛmɛtɔ ka tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye (tɛmɛtɔ 'You are wrong') fɔlɔw ye, o bɛɛ se ka tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔw ye. O tɛmɛ 'I'm not sure that's accurate' n'a 'I see it differently'.

Angɛlɛ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ, kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn bɛɛ min bɛ nafamanbɛn wɛrɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ a bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ. Kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ bɛɛ min bɛ nafamanbɛn wɛrɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ (p. ej., 'to have a good face' awɛ version 'to be in a good mood'). Angɛlɛ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ, o bɛrɛbɛ 'to be' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ 'be over the moon', Espaɲɛ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ 'estar' wala 'tener' bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ. Kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ bɛɛ min bɛ nafamanbɛn wɛrɛ, a bɛ se ka kɛlɛya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ: kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ bɛɛ min bɛ nafamanbɛn wɛrɛ ('kick the bucket') kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ bɛɛ min bɛ nafamanbɛn wɛrɛ ('pass away').

Kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn fɛ angɛlɛ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ, kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ:
1. Kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ tɛmɛ, o bɛrɛbɛ tɔɔrɔ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ.

5. Kɛlɛya sanakuya kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ (p. ej., 'to be in hot water' angɛlɛ kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ 'to be in a pickle' kanbɔrɔn wɛrɛ).
